# Butler Legal Services

> Butler Legal Services is a paralegal practice in Ajax, Ontario, run by Sierra Walker, a paralegal licensed and regulated by the Law Society of Ontario. It fights Ontario traffic tickets (Highway Traffic Act offences) for drivers: speeding, stunt driving, careless driving, distracted driving and more. It appears in person in Durham Region and nearby, and remotely at courts that allow it. It is a sister company of Notable Notary (notary, apostille and translation, https://notablenotary.ca).
